verdicts.reason: A: the CTA is shrunk to a tiny pill with near-illegible text and pushed to the bottom-left, so it is buried. The flavour list is out of the original order, set in shrinking sizes and staggered diagonally so no edge lines up, and it floats in the middle with dead blue space around it. B: the headline still wraps to leave an orphaned 'sugar.', and the list has the same diagonal stagger, reorder and shrinking sizes, with Lime Zap jammed near the bottom edge. The logo is demoted to a small pill on the far right, sitting next to the CTA. Still, B's CTA and list text are readable and the three columns use the banner better than A does.
